emotional_tone: Authoritative, functional, elite, and highly pragmatic.

color_palette.rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. The palette must feel like an engineering blueprint or architectural document.

typography.rules: No Inter. No Roboto. Headings MUST have tight tracking. Overlines MUST be uppercase and wide.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing paired with strict grids. Elements must have high contrast and clear boundaries.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Containers use border-collapse style layout.
spacing_and_layout.bento_mode: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboards. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-0 if using border collapse).

components.buttons: Flat, pure geometric. bg-[#FF3B30] text-white border border-[#1A1A1A]. Hover: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white.
components.cards: Surface #FFFFFF, hard 1px border-[#1A1A1A], no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and sharp solid offset shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1A1A1A]).
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: rounded-none, border-b-2 border-x-0 border-t-0 border-[#1A1A1A] bg-transparent focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-[#FF3B30]
components.kanban_board: Strict vertical columns. 1px borders between columns. Tasks are dense, rectangular, high contrast.
components.glassmorphism: FORBIDDEN for this archetype. Use solid backgrounds.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Duotone for marketing, Bold for dashboard.

pages_and_features.landing_page: High visual impact. Use the abstract grid paper background. Large 'Outfit' headings. Asymmetric bento layout for startup features.
pages_and_features.startup_listing: Dense bento grid of startup cards. Geometric logos, clear tags (JetBrains Mono) for tech stack.
pages_and_features.startup_detail_and_kanban: Control room layout. The task board should look like an engineering command center. Clear states (Open, Progress, Review, Completed).
pages_and_features.github_submission: Modal or slide-over with strict form layout. Paste PR URL, notes. Brutalist success/error states.
pages_and_features.verified_experience_profile: Designed to look like a printable, high-end engineering certificate. Mostly monochrome with red/blue accents for 'Verified' stamps.

hero_background.description: Minimalist grid pattern on white paper. Use as a subtle background texture to reinforce the engineering/blueprint feel.

startup_logos.description: Abstract black and white geometric logo for a featured virtual startup.
Abstract dark background with orange and red pattern for a startup logo.

student_avatars.description: Student working on laptop - Use for user profiles or testimonial sections.
Focused student engaged in programming. Perfect for dashboard profile picture.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in your HTML/CSS.
Follow Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast. Absolutely no soft shadows, gradients, or rounded corners. Set Tailwind rounded configs to 'none'.
Use 1px pure black (#1A1A1A) borders to divide dashboard sections instead of empty whitespace, adopting a 'Grid Borders / Technical' look.
The Kanban board must avoid standard 'floating cards'. Make the columns strict, full-height areas separated by borders, and tasks as flat, full-width bordered rectangles inside.
For Shadcn components (Dialogs, Select, Forms), strip out their default rounded corners and soft shadows to match this brutalist technical identity.
Use @phosphor-icons/react. Make sure you install it.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the media URLs provided in this JSON.
When building the Verified Experience Profile, aim for the aesthetic of a high-end printed document or engineering certificate (high contrast, distinct typography, authoritative).
